subject: Redwood pilot — recap, priority check, and next steps
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir.k@finwell.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood pilot — recap, priority check, and next steps

Hi Samir — great to meet earlier today. Quick recap from my side and suggested next steps so we keep momentum: 

Call summary:
- Goal: evaluate Redwood Inference for low-latency, cost-predictable inference for FinWell’s claim-triage service.
- Key constraints: HIPAA-adjacent data handling, pilot limited to 100k inference tokens/week, must run in us-west region.
- Success criteria: <20% avg token cost reduction vs current setup OR 25% latency improvement at p95.

Proposed next steps (suggested owners & timing):
1) Pilot scope + security checklist — Hannah to share pilot plan and SOC2 evidence (attached) — target to sign-off by Mar 8.
2) Procurement & PO — Samir to confirm procurement contact and budget window; procurement looped on this thread.
3) Technical kickoff — 1-hour workshop with FinWell infra and our infra team (Jonas) during the week of Mar 15.

Attachments: redwood-pilot-deck.pdf (overview + technical appendix), proposed-poc-plan.docx (scope & success metrics).

Can you confirm: (a) procurement contact & best email for PO communications, (b) whether this is still a priority for FinWell in the next 30 days?

If that timeline looks tight, tell me and we’ll propose a scaled pilot. Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0118

Hi Samir —
Just bumping this in case it got buried. I shared the pilot plan and SOC2 appendix last week. Quick reminders:
- We can start a limited pilot in us-west with no data persistence beyond the test window.
- We’re flexible on scope if procurement needs a smaller initial commitment.

If you’re the wrong person to coordinate procurement, could you please point me to the right contact? Otherwise, would a 30-minute call next Tue/Wed (Mar 16/17) work to lock the kickoff?

Appreciate a quick note either way so we can keep the slots available.

Thanks,
Hannah
